Milwaukee, WI – Weakened winds and clearing skies will lead to a chilly night across much of south-central Wisconsin, with a Frost Advisory in effect from 2 to 9 a.m. Thursday, according to the National Weather Service (NWS) Milwaukee/Sullivan.
